title: Reality of Honeytrap
description:
Behind the scenes of national security, a silent war is being fought—not with guns, but with seduction. Pakistan’s intelligence agencies are increasingly using honeytrap operations to target India’s ISRO scientists, DRDO engineers, and Army personnel.

From fake social media profiles to romantic blackmail, these traps aim to extract sensitive information, compromise national projects, and weaken our defense systems. Many victims don’t even realize they’re being played until it’s too late.

In this video, we expose how honeytraps work, the real cases that have shaken India’s security, and why awareness is our first line of defense.
